revision_history.reason: Add endpoint-partition, primary-holdout, cash-collateral term-set and state-transition controls before any outcome is viewed.

Add overlap-dependence interpretation, executable primary-holdout predicate and invalidation, explicit state-transition matrix, and conjunctive usable-strategy/risk-feasibility controls before any outcome is viewed.
Cross-bind the canonical replay freeze record and require prospective state/configuration coverage before any usable-strategy label.
Require the strict Boolean primary-holdout hurdle and the v3 effective route/account/scope/currency term-resolution controls before any outcome is viewed.
Prevent development-state carry into primary holdout, distinguish pre-submit paths, and make cash/collateral role applicability deterministic before any outcome is viewed.
Require contiguous transition-chain reconciliation, typed dated cash/margin/settlement events, explicit currency conversion and deterministic term-scope resolution before any outcome is viewed.
Close execution-model/tradability, partial-fill, fee/tax-currency and keyed endpoint-result controls before any outcome is viewed.

Add immutable replay-run binding, endpoint/population evidence, unitized lot/reconciliation, fill-leg allocation, dated broker-tax component keys, separate execution/settlement states, end-run disposition and zero-blocking prospective coverage audit controls before any outcome is viewed.
Align all frozen-run, endpoint, state, fee-component, reservation and normalized holdout-component controls to DPSFS-DD-v8 before any outcome is viewed.

purpose: Define the minimum computable, leakage-resistant protocol that a future rulebook must satisfy before a formal historical or paper replay can be labeled a test of the research criterion. It is not a strategy, allocation, holding or action.

protocol_freeze_control.unique_field_validation: required_freeze_fields is an ordered unique DD v8 schema list. Duplicate names, aliases and same-name/different-value copies are rejected before signing; every declared field resolves exactly once in replay_run_freeze_record.
protocol_freeze_control.change_control: Any change to this protocol's statistic, status rule, reporting population, output requirement, run-binding schema, endpoint audit, unit/lot/reconciliation, execution/settlement state, fill-leg, component-term FK, event-role mapping or prospective coverage gate requires a new protocol version and freeze record before outcomes are viewed.

replay_run_binding_and_bound_row_require.freeze_entity_rule: A formal run has exactly one signed immutable replay_run_freeze_record keyed by replay_run_id. replay_run_freeze_record_sha256 is the hash of the canonical freeze serialization excluding that hash field itself (or of a separately named canonical freeze artifact), not a self-referential hash of every row field. It cross-binds DPSFS-DAC-v12, DPSFS-RP0-v10, the frozen rulebook, DPSFS-DD-v8, input manifest, source cutoff, code/runtime/command and every required policy hash before outcome view. A field change, reserialization difference or changed binding creates a new run; a later report cannot retroactively bind an old row.
replay_run_binding_and_bound_row_require.bound_row_admission_rule: Every run-scoped row must carry the binding key and resolve to the one canonical record byte-for-byte. All inter-table foreign keys must retain the same key. A missing key, hash mismatch, cross-run join, duplicate business key under different bindings, inferred file-path binding or outcome-view-before-freeze row is INVALID and remains visible in the audit population.
replay_run_binding_and_bound_row_require.failure_rule: No endpoint, all-history result, PRIMARY_HOLDOUT result or usable-strategy label may use an unbound row.

fx_calendar_and_unitization_method_requi.fx_conversion_requirement: Every non-ledger-currency mark, cashflow/P&L amount, fee/tax component and cash/margin/settlement event must cite a frozen_fx_quote_conversion row by fx_quote_id/fx_quote_sha256. Its rate, observation time, policy, basis and rounding determine ledger_currency_amount, and the daily fx_quote_set_sha256 must reproduce the same set. For execution_fee_tax_component, amount equals term_calculated_amount times the selected frozen rate under fx_rounding_mode/fx_rounding_decimal_places, unless a declared identity-currency case carries the same explicit quote/basis evidence. No inferred, stale, unbound or post-cutoff FX rate is admissible.
fx_calendar_and_unitization_method_requi.calendar_coverage_requirement: The frozen master_calendar_daily_coverage_rule_id/SHA requires one bound coverage row for every required master-calendar valuation session. Candidate/result endpoint-window coverage count, covered count, set hash and status must equal the joined master_calendar_daily_valuation_coverage population; the population audit must separately reconcile evaluation-warmup coverage. A gap, duplicate, out-of-range session or non-covered status is INCOMPLETE or INVALID and cannot be shortened away.
fx_calendar_and_unitization_method_requi.unitization_nav_bridge_requirement: Every unitization row binds the frozen method ID/version/SHA, external_flow_pricing_unit_nav and unitization_calculation_input_set_sha256. The unique first OPENING row has a null prior_unitization_ledger_id and opening_units zero. Every non-OPENING row must reference exactly one immediate temporal predecessor ordered by valuation_at then unitization_ledger_id, with prior valuation_at strictly earlier and opening_units equal byte-for-byte to its prior closing_units; reset, gap, reversal or alternate predecessor paths are INVALID. The frozen method definition fixes external-flow timing, opening rule and rounding. daily_portfolio_ledger.nav_bridge_input_set_sha256 then binds the unitization, marked positions/lots, cashflow/P&L and signed event postings, so external cash flows cannot create reported TWRR.
fx_calendar_and_unitization_method_requi.event_balance_and_time_order_requirement: Each cash/margin/settlement event must state balance_effect_bucket/sign, ledger-currency conversion and FX evidence, formula/input-set hash, and, for settlement calculations, prior/current settlement price, calculation_quantity_or_contracts, settlement_obligation_status, unpaid ledger-currency amount and cashflow_pnl_id. effective_at, source, fill and transition times must be causally ordered; daily event_balance_routing_set_sha256 and residual reconciliation must prove each signed posting occurs once. Gross notional, variation/final settlement and unsettled obligations cannot be netted away.
fx_calendar_and_unitization_method_requi.failure_rule: Any missing parent binding, conversion quote, coverage row, method definition, NAV-bridge input, balance routing, formula input or causal time order is INVALID.

objective_boundary.research_criterion: The strict historical research hurdle is that every complete eligible rolling five-calendar-year endpoint has annualized net TWRR at or above 5%.
mandatory_disclosures: Every eligible endpoint, including INCOMPLETE and INVALID status.
Minimum annualized net TWRR, count and proportion below 5%, and all endpoint rows.
Overlapping-window dependence; endpoint counts are not independent evidence.
All material no-fill, missing-data, exception and revision effects.
prohibited_interpretations: Return guarantee, annual floor, forecast, probability estimate or suitability conclusion.
Hiding an incomplete endpoint, survivor, no-fill, event, cost or rule-change state.
Using the exploratory public ETF diagnostic as proof for or against the criterion.

interpretation_and_robustness_controls.overlap_dependency_boundary: Rolling five-calendar-year endpoints overlap substantially. Endpoint count is a reporting-population control, not an independent sample size, probability estimate or frequency-of-success claim.
interpretation_and_robustness_controls.non_overlapping_summary_rule: Alongside the all-endpoint table, freeze a deterministic auxiliary non-overlapping window selection before outcomes: order eligible windows by window_start then endpoint date, retain the first, and retain each later window only when its window_start is after the prior retained window_end. Report every eligible/retained/excluded row and the selection rule; it cannot replace the all-endpoint hurdle.
interpretation_and_robustness_controls.regime_and_stress_summary_rule: Freeze an ex-ante regime/stress calendar or point-in-time classification rule, its source inputs, cutoffs and labels before outcome view. Report all eligible endpoint and daily-ledger observations by each declared regime/stress label, including unavailable/uncategorized rows. No regime may be selected, merged or removed after returns are viewed.
interpretation_and_robustness_controls.interpretation_rule: A pass is only a pathwise historical constraint under the frozen protocol. It must never be described as independent confirmation, a probability, a forecast, a return guarantee or a personal feasibility conclusion.

portfolio_unitization.external_cash_flow_treatment: On a frozen valuation session, compute pre-flow marked NAV, then issue or redeem units at pre-flow unit NAV and record the external flow after the return subperiod closes. The ledger retains the pre-flow NAV, unit count, flow, issued/redeemed units and post-flow NAV. An unlogged cash adjustment is prohibited.
portfolio_unitization.internal_cash_treatment: Distributions, coupons, variation margin, interest, fees, taxes and redemptions are internal ledger events. A distribution remains strategy cash until a later rule-generated trade; no automatic reinvestment is assumed.
portfolio_unitization.nonpositive_nav_treatment: If pre-flow NAV, post-flow NAV or outstanding unit count is zero or negative, the affected endpoint is INVALID. No silent rebase, return reset or reconnection across an insolvency/zero-NAV state is permitted. A later external flow starts a separately labeled inactive/restart ledger that cannot create a continuous historical TWRR.
portfolio_unitization.scale_boundary: The economic replay is unitized. Integer lots, minimum fees, margin and other implementation constraints must be reported in a separate frozen feasibility treatment; this does not constrain the research mandate.
portfolio_unitization.result_scope_boundary: A unitized economic replay is not a personal net-result claim. A later personal implementation conclusion requires separately accepted route, cost, integer-lot, margin and feasibility evidence.
portfolio_unitization.economic_position_and_reservation_rule: economic_closing_quantity and marked NAV reflect actual filled economic positions only. An unfilled sell reservation reduces available_to_sell capacity but must not reduce economic_closing_quantity, marked value or NAV. ETF position_side may only be LONG or FLAT: ETF SHORT inventory and all OPEN_SHORT/CLOSE_SHORT order or fill paths require an out-of-scope borrow model and are forbidden. execution_feasibility_reservation aggregates by cash, margin and lot pool; aggregate active reservations cannot exceed the same pool's eligible before-balance or reserve the same lot/cash/margin twice.

reconciliation_expected_matrix_control.set_reconciliation_rule: expected_reconciliation_row_count equals the mandatory row count plus applicable conditional rows; actual_reconciliation_residual_row_count equals expected_reconciliation_row_count; expected_reconciliation_matrix_set_sha256 is the generated expected-row hash; and reconciliation_residual_set_sha256 is the actual set hash with exact expected-matrix membership. Any mismatch is INVALID.

portfolio_unitization.start_state_ledger_rule: Each PRIMARY_HOLDOUT start-state manifest must have normalized primary_holdout_start_state_component rows foreign-keying each declared unit, position/lot/mark, cashflow/P&L and reconciliation component to a bound ledger row at state_reset_at or window_start. An aggregate NAV, hashes without component membership rows, an unexplained zero balance or a reset without explicit unit-count/no-position/no-obligation records cannot establish a start state.
portfolio_unitization.transaction_time_feasibility_rule: At every DECISION, SUBMISSION and FILL context_at, execution_feasibility_reservation records the applicable cash, collateral, margin or lot pool. A FILL row carries its fill_id; a listed-security sale links position_id, lot_id and available_to_sell_from to the dated T+1 rule, with eligible_to_sell_quantity, active_sell_reservation_quantity and available_to_sell_quantity resolved in portfolio_position_lot_mark_ledger. Before/preexisting/new/after reservation balances must reconcile and may not double-reserve the same cash, margin or T+1 lot. economic_closing_quantity and NAV remain economic quantities and are not reduced by an unfilled sell reservation. Released/cancelled/carry reservation entries are timestamped. Fractional economic unitization does not waive integer lot, T+1, cash or margin feasibility evidence.

master_calendar.required: Freeze a named master portfolio calendar, each asset-specific calendar, holiday handling, valuation session, non-trading mark policy, cash/funding accrual convention and negative-NAV/insolvency state before data outcomes are viewed.

rolling_window_rule.calendar_anchor: For each eligible master-calendar end date e, set calendar anchor a to the same month/day five calendar years before e; for February 29 use February 28 in a non-leap year.
rolling_window_rule.start_selection: Set s to the last valid master portfolio valuation date on or before a. Record e, a, s and elapsed calendar days in every endpoint row.
rolling_window_rule.annualization: annualized_net_twrr = (end_unit_nav / start_unit_nav)^(365.2425 / elapsed_calendar_days) - 1. A total-NAV ratio is prohibited whenever external cash flows exist; endpoint_calculation_sha256 must cover the unit-NAV inputs, external-flow treatment and formula.
rolling_window_rule.reporting_population: Before validation, freeze an evaluation start/end interval and include every master-calendar end date e whose calendar anchor a lies within the declared raw-data coverage interval. Every candidate endpoint receives a status; data quality cannot remove it from the reporting population.
rolling_window_rule.minimum_candidate_endpoint_rationale: Require at least 252 all-history master-calendar endpoints before the result may be described as a rolling-window test. Overlap remains disclosed and does not make endpoint rows independent evidence.
rolling_window_rule.expected_candidate_endpoint_match_rule: The actual_candidate_endpoint_count must equal the frozen expected_candidate_endpoint_count. Any mismatch is INCOMPLETE, remains visible in the endpoint report and cannot pass.
rolling_window_rule.endpoint_partition_reconciliation_rule: Every candidate endpoint appears exactly once in DEVELOPMENT, PRIMARY_HOLDOUT or CROSSING. The frozen all-history candidate count equals the sum of the three partition counts; a duplicate, unclassified endpoint or count-reconciliation mismatch is INVALID.
rolling_window_rule.endpoint_count_requirement: Report expected_candidate_endpoint_count, actual_candidate_endpoint_count, PASS_count, FAIL_count, INCOMPLETE_count and INVALID_count. If actual_candidate_endpoint_count differs from the frozen expected count, is below the frozen minimum or is zero, the formal result is INCOMPLETE and cannot pass.
rolling_window_rule.valid_calculation: A PASS or FAIL requires s and e to have valid reconciled NAV, positive elapsed_calendar_days, and every intervening master session to have a declared ledger state.
rolling_window_rule.missing_endpoint_policy: A candidate endpoint with missing input, ledger, provenance, event, cost or rule state is INCOMPLETE or INVALID under the status policy; it is retained in the endpoint table and vetoes the strict result.

status_policy.INCOMPLETE: Expected input, ledger state, provenance, event reconciliation, cost term or rule state is missing or unresolved.
status_policy.INVALID: A protocol, entitlement, lineage, point-in-time or deterministic-rerun breach affects the endpoint.

endpoint_status_validation.validation_rule: After INVALID and INCOMPLETE precedence checks, endpoint_status is PASS if annualized_net_twrr >= 0.05 and FAIL if annualized_net_twrr < 0.05. The signed endpoint_calculation_sha256 binds the metric inputs, external-cashflow treatment and formula; a status not mechanically equal to this rule is INVALID.

rolling_window_rule.strict_result_rule: The all-history formal historical hurdle is passed only if actual_candidate_endpoint_count equals the frozen expected count, meets the frozen minimum and every candidate endpoint in DEVELOPMENT, PRIMARY_HOLDOUT and CROSSING is PASS. Any count mismatch, zero-count, FAIL, INCOMPLETE or INVALID state, including a CROSSING endpoint, is not a pass.

endpoint_calculation_and_population_audi.canonical_date_rule: calendar_anchor_at, selected_start_valuation_at, endpoint_end_valuation_at, window_start, window_end and elapsed_calendar_days are canonical stored audit fields, not presentation values. selected_start_valuation_at is s, the specified master-calendar session at or before anchor a; endpoint_end_valuation_at is e; window_start must equal s and window_end must equal e. Elapsed days must be positive and match s-to-e; required_window_calendar_days must match the frozen five-calendar-year rule; start/end daily-ledger foreign keys must resolve to the exact recorded dates and total/unit NAVs. annualized_net_twrr uses end_unit_nav/start_unit_nav (or chain-linked unit NAV), never total NAV ratio when external cash flows exist, and endpoint_calculation_sha256 covers the formula and flow treatment.

roster_membership_and_partition_equality.roster_identity_rule: Every replay_candidate_endpoint_roster row has candidate_endpoint_roster_id and candidate_endpoint_roster_sha256 equal byte-for-byte to replay_run_freeze_record. Candidate generation, membership, calendar_anchor_at, selected_start_valuation_at, endpoint_end_valuation_at, elapsed_calendar_days and expected_partition are frozen row values; no regenerated, filtered or alternate roster is admissible.
roster_membership_and_partition_equality.partition_count_rule: The count of roster rows by expected_partition must equal expected_development_count, expected_primary_holdout_candidate_endpoint_count and expected_crossing_count respectively; replay_endpoint_result.endpoint_partition must equal the joined roster.expected_partition for every candidate_endpoint_id. Any missing, duplicate, mismatched, reclassified or unrepresented candidate is INVALID.

endpoint_calculation_and_population_audi.count_audit_rule: expected_candidate_endpoint_count equals actual_candidate_endpoint_count equals the unique roster count; expected and actual DEVELOPMENT, PRIMARY_HOLDOUT and CROSSING counts reconcile; status_count_total equals pass_count plus fail_count plus incomplete_count plus invalid_count and equals actual_candidate_endpoint_count; and count_residual is zero with population_reconciliation_status PASS. Every endpoint result joins exactly one roster row using the frozen run binding and candidate_endpoint_id. A missing candidate, duplicate key, absent date/ledger evidence or count discrepancy cannot be hidden by reducing the population.

required_bindings: formal replay protocol ID, version and SHA-256
frozen U0 population and decision-universe SHA-256
DPSFS-DD-v8 ID/schema/SHA-256 and raw/normalized input-manifest hashes
replay code commit, deterministic runtime lock/hash and exact run command
freeze timestamp, approvers and first-permitted-outcome-view timestamp
canonical data-contract freeze-record SHA-256 and exact crosswalk equality audit
primary-holdout predicate ID/SHA-256, lockbox start/end, maximum input-lookback/warmup and start-state policy
canonical endpoint calculation/population-audit and count-reconciliation schemas
unitization, position/lot/mark, cashflow/P&L, reconciliation and transaction-time reservation/T+1 policies

conditional submission-path/timestamp, cash/collateral role-applicability, scope-resolution, exact event-type/application-role mapping, transition-chain/event-schema, execution-model/tradability, separate execution/settlement state, end-of-run carry/cancel, fill-leg/partial-fill allocation, broker-tax component FKs, fee-tax/currency, prospective-coverage and endpoint-result policies
pre_result_freeze_and_blinding.blinding_rule: No holdout outcome may be opened before the full binding record is signed. Windows crossing a development/holdout boundary are tagged CROSSING and never represented as independent holdout results.
pre_result_freeze_and_blinding.canonical_freeze_record_rule: The sole authoritative binding artifact is governance/data_contract_freeze_record.json represented by the immutable replay_run_freeze_record keyed by replay_run_id. It must cross-bind DPSFS-DAC-v12, DPSFS-RP0-v10, the rulebook, U0 snapshot/derivation, DPSFS-DD-v8, input manifest, source-revision cutoff, code/runtime/command bundle, lockbox/predicate, primary-holdout start-state policy, canonical endpoint/population audit, unitization/lot/mark/cashflow/reconciliation and transaction-time reservation policy, state-transition matrix, conditional submission-path/timestamp policy, cash/collateral role-applicability and scope-resolution policies, exact event-role mapping, order-transition-chain invariant, cash/margin/settlement event schema, execution-model/tradability, separate execution/settlement state, end-of-run carry/cancel, fill-leg/partial-fill allocation, broker-tax component FKs, fee-tax/currency, prospective coverage and endpoint-result policies, and risk-feasibility pack. Every referenced ID/version/SHA-256 and timing value echoed by every bound runtime, order, transition, fill, ledger, audit and endpoint row must equal the canonical record byte-for-byte. A missing or mismatch is INVALID and invalidates PRIMARY_HOLDOUT and all-history result labels.
pre_result_freeze_and_blinding.result_population_rule: Freeze three mutually exclusive endpoint tables: DEVELOPMENT contains endpoints wholly inside the development interval; PRIMARY_HOLDOUT contains endpoints wholly inside the lockbox-holdout interval; CROSSING contains every boundary-crossing endpoint. Every candidate endpoint is in exactly one table. The primary out-of-sample result is PRIMARY_HOLDOUT and never uses CROSSING as a substitute. The all-history research hurdle is DEVELOPMENT plus PRIMARY_HOLDOUT plus CROSSING; a FAIL, INCOMPLETE or INVALID CROSSING endpoint vetoes the all-history hurdle. Report the three table counts, their reconciled total and the primary-holdout result separately.
pre_result_freeze_and_blinding.primary_holdout_endpoint_rule: Freeze expected_primary_holdout_candidate_endpoint_count before any outcome view. The PRIMARY_HOLDOUT strict hurdle passes if and only if actual_primary_holdout_candidate_endpoint_count equals expected_primary_holdout_candidate_endpoint_count, that common count is at least 126, and every PRIMARY_HOLDOUT candidate endpoint is PASS. A zero, shortfall, mismatch, FAIL, INCOMPLETE or INVALID primary-holdout endpoint makes the primary out-of-sample result INCOMPLETE or FAIL as applicable; no independent out-of-sample or validated-strategy result may be claimed.
pre_result_freeze_and_blinding.primary_holdout_window_predicate: A window is PRIMARY_HOLDOUT only if window_start is no earlier than lockbox_holdout_start plus the frozen maximum input-lookback/warmup interval, window_end is no later than lockbox_holdout_end, every decision input, universe record, cost term and action used from state_reset_at through window_end has available_at at or after lockbox_holdout_start, and the primary-holdout start-state manifest has integrity_status PASS. state_reset_at must be at or after lockbox_holdout_start and no later than window_start. At window_start, unit NAV, positions, cash/debit/accruals, margin/collateral, unsettled obligations, open orders/transitions, roll/delivery/expiry state and decision-affecting parameter/signal state must be a deterministic neutral reset or reconstructed solely from post-lockbox inputs and rule-generated actions during the frozen warmup. Any candidate not wholly satisfying this predicate is CROSSING or INVALID as applicable; it cannot enter PRIMARY_HOLDOUT by endpoint date alone.
pre_result_freeze_and_blinding.primary_holdout_start_state_rule: For every PRIMARY_HOLDOUT endpoint, retain exactly one hash-bound primary_holdout_start_state_manifest and its normalized primary_holdout_start_state_component membership rows. Each component row identifies component_type, component_row_reference, referenced_table_id, the applicable typed ledger foreign key, component_source_available_at, post_lockbox_provenance_status, component_integrity_status and referenced_row_sha256; the manifest records start_state_component_row_count and start_state_component_set_sha256. Aggregate NAV, component hashes without membership rows, an unexplained zero balance or a reset without explicit unit-count/no-position/no-obligation records cannot establish a start state. A component sourced before lockbox_holdout_start, a development-period carry, a missing component, a mismatch to the daily/order/lot ledger or an unverifiable neutral reset causes CROSSING or INVALID. A warmup is valid only when it occurs entirely post-lockbox and is fully reproducible from frozen inputs/actions.
pre_result_freeze_and_blinding.holdout_invalidation_rule: Any rulebook, parameter, U0 snapshot/derivation, input transformation, data-revision treatment, run-binding/dictionary schema, start-state/unitization/lot/reconciliation policy, endpoint population/calculation policy, cost/execution model/tradability, execution-settlement/end-run policy, conditional submission-path policy, fill-leg/partial-fill policy, broker-tax component FK/event-role mapping/fee-tax-currency policy, cash/collateral role/scope policy, prospective coverage audit schema, endpoint-result schema or endpoint-partition predicate change after the lockbox freeze invalidates the prior PRIMARY_HOLDOUT result. A new version requires a new lockbox interval and no prior holdout outcome may be reused as validation.
pre_result_freeze_and_blinding.validated_result_rule: A result may be described as a validated historical research result only when both the all-history strict hurdle and the PRIMARY_HOLDOUT strict hurdle pass. An all-history result with an incomplete or failed primary holdout is descriptive only and cannot support a usable-strategy conclusion.
pre_result_freeze_and_blinding.usable_strategy_status_rule: A strategy may be called usable for research purposes only when all of the following hold together: the all-history strict hurdle passes with a matching candidate roster/population count audit; the PRIMARY_HOLDOUT strict hurdle passes with every keyed endpoint, start-state manifest and unit/lot/reconciliation foreign key passing; every run-scoped row has the immutable canonical binding; U0-to-T2 coverage and every represented class module are accepted; entitled point-in-time data, lineage and replay acceptance are complete; the frozen risk-and-feasibility control pack passes; dated route/cost/terms, broker-tax component FKs, event-role mapping, execution-model/tradability, deterministic scope/role, transaction-time lot/T+1/reservation, fill-leg/partial-fill, separate execution/settlement/end-run and no-fill evidence pass; every order-transition-chain and typed cash/margin/settlement/fee-tax event reconciles with explicit currency/unit treatment; the prospective paper-reconciliation gate passes only when the hash-bound coverage table has zero rows with coverage_disposition UNRESOLVED or FAILED, zero rows with review_status other than PASS, and zero missing expected configuration_tuple_sha256 values; and no severity-S or unwaived severity-A review finding remains. Otherwise the status remains q=0. This label is not a return guarantee, forecast, probability estimate, personal suitability conclusion or investment action.
pre_result_freeze_and_blinding.parameter_control: Every parameter candidate, rejected alternative, rationale and selection timestamp is retained. A parameter cannot be chosen or changed in response to a viewed holdout result.

point_in_time_and_population_controls.decision_filter: Reject a record whose available_at is later than the frozen decision cutoff. A later revision is retained but cannot replace the vintage used by the original decision.
point_in_time_and_population_controls.population_rule: Use the frozen U0-derived point-in-time master, retaining listings, suspensions, mergers, terminations, delistings and futures expiries. A current survivor-only population is prohibited.
point_in_time_and_population_controls.universe_selection_rule: Discovery, class qualification and selection are separate. A named data probe, an attractive product label or missing data in another class cannot define the future decision universe.

universe_derivation_and_scope_control.required_derivation_audit: Before a T2 freeze, retain the U0 snapshot hash, per-class population and qualified counts, each T2 item's parent_class_id, rule ID, inclusion/exclusion reason and independently approved exception log.
universe_derivation_and_scope_control.class_module_gate: Every U0 parent class represented in a formal T2 universe must have a class-specific accepted data package, event/lifecycle accounting and replay-protocol module. A class without an accepted module cannot enter that run.
universe_derivation_and_scope_control.restricted_result_label: If the formal run covers fewer than all in-scope U0 classes, it must disclose every omitted/unqualified class and be labeled as a coverage-restricted test by included class. It cannot be described as an open domestic multi-asset strategy test.
universe_derivation_and_scope_control.optional_class_boundary: A class can be absent only through a frozen U0 derivation rule and auditable failed gate, not manual nomination or convenience.

unbound_before_future_freeze: Exact score formula and direction.
Minimum history and missing-lookback treatment.
Tie-breaker, overlap-cluster method, substitutions and no-eligible-item state.
Target-weight, residual-cash, rebalance-tolerance and integer-lot feasibility rule.
Decision/order/implementation timestamps, executable price side, mark convention and order-expiry/retry policy.
Partial-fill, T+1 cash and position state, halt, price-limit and no-fill transitions.
Market-price versus NAV basis, event ordering, tax posting, split/merger/redemption/termination treatment and cash/funding convention.
listed_security_rule_requirements.mandatory_total_return_control: A declared market-price/NAV basis is reconciled to a separate event ledger. An adjusted price field cannot be combined with the same cash event without a documented no-double-count reconciliation.
mandatory_order_ledger_fields: broker-route identifier and effective broker/cash-collateral term references
cash-collateral term-set identifier and order-state-transition ledger reference
execution-model ID/basis, legal session and typed tradability status
execution side plus target, submitted, filled, partial-residual, expired/cancelled or no-fill quantity
submitted, filled, expiry, cancellation and settlement timestamps/states
quote-snapshot or conservative-proxy composite key, quote age and quote-before-submit/fill causality check
execution price, spread/impact, dated fee/tax components/currencies and settlement state
mark price and resulting position/cash state

futures_rule_requirements.actual_contract_boundary: Actual listed contracts only. A continuous or retrospectively labeled main-contract series cannot be P&L, roll or hidden signal-history evidence.
unbound_before_future_freeze: Return definition, exact observation endpoints and missing-history treatment.
Contract-history construction permitted for a point-in-time signal.
Signal weights, volatility formula and numerical liquidity/open-interest thresholds.
Delivery-buffer, limit-lock, status, margin, position-limit and broker-route thresholds.
Contract ranking, tie-breaker, roll trigger, successor, timing, price side and integer quantity rule.
Contract multiplier/tick/unit, final-settlement/expiry treatment and unavailable-successor state.
Margin reserve, gross-notional/leverage/group/instrument caps, collateral yield, variation-margin and forced-liquidation treatment.
Repeated no-fill, reduction and risk-retention state machine.
mandatory_contract_controls: Use the same-day full cross-section and lifecycle state available before the next eligible action.
Bind each selected contract to effective rule, fee, margin, limit, position and delivery terms.
Mark daily variation P&L at actual settlement; close is a separate observation.
Record every roll leg, no-fill, partial fill, constraint breach and collateral movement.

unbound_before_future_freeze: Point-in-time underlying and full option-chain population, including expired series, strikes, expiry and adjustment history.
Premium, quote/depth timestamp, multiplier, exercise/assignment, settlement and corporate-adjustment accounting.
Position, margin, exercise/assignment, liquidity, route and suitability gates.
Chain selection, tie-breaker, expiry handling, quantity, payoff/risk aggregation and no-fill state machine.
Underlying synchronization, final exercise/assignment cashflow and all-option risk-limit treatment.
mandatory_option_controls: No option series is selected before its full contemporaneous chain and lifecycle are retained.
Every exercise, assignment, expiry, corporate adjustment and premium flow is posted once to the daily ledger.
Quoted premium, margin and underlying information must satisfy their own available_at cutoffs.
A missing chain, assignment state, margin term or executable quote produces the frozen no-fill/exclusion state.

execution_allowed_transitions: SUBMITTED->PARTIAL, FILLED, NO_FILL, EXPIRED, CANCELLED, REJECTED or FAILED
PARTIAL->PARTIAL, FILLED, PARTIAL_EXPIRED or PARTIAL_CANCELLED; PARTIAL->FAILED and PARTIAL->CANCELLED are forbidden
CREATED->REJECTED is the only permitted pre-submit rejection path; CREATED->NOT_SUBMITTED is the only no-submission path

PARTIAL_EXPIRED/PARTIAL_CANCELLED/FILLED/EXPIRED/CANCELLED/NO_FILL/REJECTED/NOT_SUBMITTED/FAILED are terminal execution states; CREATED/SUBMITTED/PARTIAL may remain open only with an explicit end-of-run disposition
settlement_allowed_transitions: A positive fill starts settlement_state PENDING unless the documented route clears at the fill timestamp; only then is NOT_APPLICABLE->SETTLED allowed, with transition_reason_code DOCUMENTED_INSTANTANEOUS_CLEARING, positive fill-time equality, linked settlement event and source evidence.
NOT_APPLICABLE applies only to zero-fill/no-cash-transfer paths with source-backed reason.
NOT_APPLICABLE, SETTLED and FAILED are terminal settlement states. End-of-run carry/cancel is recorded only in end_of_run_order_disposition, not as a settlement state.
order_state_transition_matrix_requiremen.timestamp_rule: For submission_path SUBMITTED, decision_at <= submitted_at <= filled_at, expires_at, cancelled_at, rejected_at or failed_at as applicable. For REJECTED_PRE_SUBMISSION, submitted_at is null and CREATED->REJECTED/rejected_at occurs at or after decision_at. For NOT_SUBMITTED, submitted_at, rejected_at, filled_at and expires_at are null and CREATED->NOT_SUBMITTED occurs at or after decision_at. Execution and settlement transition sequences are independently nondecreasing; settlement cannot precede its referenced fill. A path outside its own table's matrix is INVALID.
order_state_transition_matrix_requiremen.transition_chain_invariant: For each order, execution_order_state_transition sequences are exactly 1..N, begin at CREATED, have adjacent from_execution_state/to_execution_state continuity, use only allowed execution edges and end in execution_order_ledger.execution_state. execution_order_settlement_transition is a separate contiguous chain with from_settlement_state/to_settlement_state and ends in execution_order_ledger.settlement_state. SETTLED is never an execution state; SUBMITTED and FAILED are valid execution states, and settlement FAILED is not an execution FAILED. Filled/partial/no-fill/expiry/cancellation/rejection/not-submitted quantities and reasons reconcile exactly to execution transitions; partial filled legs retain settlement events. Any side chain, gap, disconnected edge, cross-domain state merge or timestamp/state/quantity mismatch is INVALID.
order_state_transition_matrix_requiremen.end_of_run_carry_cancel_requirement: At replay end every order has one end_of_run_order_disposition. Terminal orders use NO_OPEN_ORDER. Any nonterminal CREATED, SUBMITTED or PARTIAL order is CANCELLED_AT_RUN_END or EXPIRED_AT_RUN_END unless CARRIED_WITH_OPENING_STATE is explicitly permitted by the frozen end_of_run_carry_cancel_policy_sha256 and links a hash-bound next-run opening-state manifest. Carry has no unlinked result and cannot cross into a PRIMARY_HOLDOUT window; cancellation/expiry does not erase positive filled-leg, fee/tax or settlement obligations. Missing or implicit treatment is INVALID.
order_state_transition_matrix_requiremen.freeze_requirement: The eventual rulebook binds this exact matrix or a versioned replacement before outcome view; any replacement creates a new protocol/rulebook version and invalidates comparable holdout results.

prospective_paper_state_configuration_co.coverage_rule: The prospective period does not manufacture rare events. Exactly one configuration_tuple_sha256 row is required for every frozen applicable parent class, broker route/terms revision, cash-collateral term set/term/scope/role, material transaction/event, execution-model/tradability, execution/settlement/residual/end-of-run path. The row must be OBSERVED, ACCEPTED_CONSERVATIVE or SOURCE_PROVEN_NOT_APPLICABLE with evidence_reference and review_status PASS. UNRESOLVED, FAILED, a missing expected tuple or non-PASS review blocks usable-strategy status.
prospective_paper_state_configuration_co.uniqueness_rule: coverage_row_id is unique within replay_run_id and configuration_tuple_sha256 is unique within replay_run_id. A duplicate, missing configuration tuple or different run-binding hash is INVALID rather than a way to reduce the blocking count.
prospective_paper_state_configuration_co.zero_blocking_rows_rule: The derived zero-blocking assertion is true only when the count of rows with coverage_disposition UNRESOLVED or FAILED, plus rows with review_status other than PASS, plus missing expected configuration tuples, equals zero. It must be calculated from the hash-bound table; a narrative declaration, omitted tuple or aggregate netting is INVALID.
prospective_paper_state_configuration_co.minimum_count_boundary: The 60-calendar-day and 10-distinct-observation minimum remains necessary but cannot substitute for the full hash-bound state/configuration coverage audit and its zero-blocking-row assertion.

fill_event_link_allocation_control.nonlinkable_event_rule: Each listed event has zero execution_fill_ledger_event_link rows and fill_event_link_set_sha256 equal to the canonical empty set hash; a link on a nonlinkable event is INVALID.

fill_leg_and_partial_fill_allocation_req.leg_invariant: Fill sequence begins at one, is contiguous and immutable; every positive fill is in the stated quantity unit; cumulative_filled_quantity equals prior cumulative plus the fill; remaining_submitted_quantity equals submitted minus cumulative; and final order filled quantity equals the sum of fills. Every fill_id references or sequence-binds a matching execution_order_state_transition, and fill timestamp/cumulative/remaining quantities reconcile to that transition; cancellation/expiry cannot precede a later fill. Each fill's price/currency/quote-or-proxy source, direct fee/tax component allocation and settlement allocation are separately retained.
fill_leg_and_partial_fill_allocation_req.allocation_invariant: The order-level execution consideration, fee/tax components and settlement amounts equal the exact sum of fill-linked execution_fee_tax_component and execution_fill_ledger_event_link rows in their stated currency or with explicit frozen FX conversion. No later aggregate cost, estimated residual cost or order-level override may replace a fill allocation.
fill_leg_and_partial_fill_allocation_req.partial_fill_invariant: A PARTIAL order has positive cumulative fill below submitted quantity and retains its residual through a later fill, PARTIAL_EXPIRED, PARTIAL_CANCELLED or permitted end-of-run disposition. PARTIAL->FAILED is forbidden. Filled portions retain their linked settlement and fee/tax allocation; a partial order cannot become a zero-fill NO_FILL/EXPIRED record or settle its submitted quantity.
fill_leg_and_partial_fill_allocation_req.failure_rule: A missing leg, noncontiguous sequence, invalid arithmetic, absent component term FK/currency, missing settlement allocation or order-leg aggregation mismatch is INVALID.

paired_transfer_settlement_and_futures_m.event_routing_requirement: CASH_ACCRUAL, TRADE_SETTLEMENT, FEES_TAX and MARGIN_TRANSFER_CASH_LEG post only to CASH; DEBIT is permitted only for a nonnegative DEBIT_ACCRUAL liability posting. COLLATERAL_TRANSFER posts only to COLLATERAL; INITIAL_MARGIN and MAINTENANCE_MARGIN post only to MARGIN. Each event has one signed posted_balance_effect_ledger_currency_amount in exactly one daily bucket. The frozen daily NAV bridge is daily_nav_bridge_from_balances_translated_marks_and_signed_unsettled_residuals.

paired_transfer_conservation_contract.conservation_rule: Each pair has exactly one negative CASH_LEG and one positive MARGIN_LEG or COLLATERAL_LEG in the same run, daily ledger, ledger currency and effective time. Its two amounts sum to zero, net_nav_effect is zero, transfer_pair_status is PAIRED and the two legs enter separate daily-balance formulas exactly once. Every INITIAL_MARGIN, MAINTENANCE_MARGIN and COLLATERAL_TRANSFER event must belong to exactly one immutable pair.
paired_transfer_conservation_contract.dated_collateral_source_requirement: A COLLATERAL_TRANSFER resolves a cash_collateral_terms row with term_type COLLATERAL_TRANSFER, positive dated rate_or_timing_value in the declared currency unit, effective source_revision/source_reference, and event effective_at equal to the transfer term. The exact negative cash leg is required in the same pair; an inferred reserve or unpriced transfer is INVALID.

paired_transfer_settlement_and_futures_m.unsettled_settlement_payable_receivable_: settlement_obligation_status is NOT_APPLICABLE, UNSETTLED, PARTIALLY_SETTLED, SETTLED or FAILED. Gross, posted-or-paid and outstanding amounts satisfy gross minus posted equals outstanding; an unsettled direction is PAYABLE or RECEIVABLE, and NOT_APPLICABLE/SETTLED is NONE. The payable, receivable and signed net-NAV components are retained separately, with net-NAV equal to receivable less payable and admitted exactly once into the daily bridge. FAILED requires zero posted/paid amount, outstanding equal to gross, a PAYABLE/RECEIVABLE direction, final settlement state FAILED and source/exception evidence; it is never silently settled or a completed delivery/position close.
paired_transfer_settlement_and_futures_m.futures_daily_mtm_requirement: FUTURES_DAILY_MARGINED is mandatory for daily-margined futures: marked_value, marked_value_ledger_currency and unrealized_pnl are zero; futures_daily_margin_notional_reference is exposure-only and excluded from NAV/TWRR. Variation/final settlement uses prior/current settlement prices, quantity and dated multiplier, with a single linked P&L/cashflow posting. Futures TRADE_SETTLEMENT principal is zero except for a separately typed auditable futures_non_notional_adjustment_amount; it cannot use fill gross_notional as a cash/NAV substitute.
paired_transfer_settlement_and_futures_m.endpoint_invalidation_requirement: The frozen status rule requires no-failed-settlement-in-endpoint-state and failed-settlement-contract-pass. A FAILED settlement or failed transfer/unsettled assertion makes the affected endpoint INVALID, blocks PASS and remains in the population audit.
paired_transfer_settlement_and_futures_m.failure_rule: Wrong routing, hidden debit financing, unpaired or nonzero-NAV transfer, missing dated collateral source, unsigned/double-counted settlement residual, FAILED treated as settled, futures notional in NAV or endpoint PASS despite a failed settlement is INVALID.

broker_tax_component_foreign_key_and_eve.component_fk_rule: Each execution_fee_tax_component is directly allocated to one fill_id (or an explicit order-level exception path), has one component_type from COMMISSION, EXCHANGE_FEE, CLEARING_FEE, OTHER_FEE, TAX or LEVY, and has exactly one effective broker_fee_term_id/source_revision or tax_levy_term_id/source_revision as appropriate. The referenced term must deterministically match component_at, route, account, instrument-or-product scope, currency and, for TAX/LEVY, jurisdiction. term_calculated_amount in term_output_currency converts to amount/currency only through the frozen_fx_quote_conversion cited by fx_quote_id/fx_quote_sha256, fx_conversion_rate and declared rounding; amount must equal the rounded multiplication, and an identity-currency case must be explicit rather than inferred. Combined, implicit-zero, untyped generic fee/tax, null-currency or unresolved-jurisdiction components are prohibited.
broker_tax_component_foreign_key_and_eve.event_role_rule: Every cashflow/P&L and cash/margin/settlement event stores exactly one event_type and the mapped application_role above. Its role, term family, amount and currency must agree with the mapping. FEES_TAX maps to NOT_APPLICABLE_FEE_TAX and its CASH_BALANCE role applicability is separately audited; direct components use broker/tax terms, not cash-yield, debit, collateral or margin pricing terms.
broker_tax_component_foreign_key_and_eve.failure_rule: A missing/non-effective term FK, component ambiguity, currency/jurisdiction/scope mismatch or event-role mapping mismatch is INVALID.

transaction_time_lot_reservation_require.rule: Every transaction is feasible at each DECISION, SUBMISSION and FILL context_at. A FILL row carries its fill_id; sales link position_id/lot_id/available_to_sell_from to the dated T+1 rule; reservations are scoped to a cash, collateral, margin or lot pool with before/preexisting/new/after balances and cannot double-reserve the same pool. Release/carry after cancellation, fill or end-of-run is timestamped and reconciles to the unitized daily ledger. A fractional unitized result is not evidence that an integer-lot or funding reservation was feasible.

cost_causality: Apply dated fee/tax schedules, minimum commission, lot/tick, bid/ask or frozen conservative proxy, impact model, quote timestamp, quote age and quote/depth size.
Do not assume zero cost or a guaranteed fill.
Fund-level expenses embedded in NAV are not charged again as investor transaction costs.

A transaction is valid only if a legal session, typed ETF/futures tradability row, frozen execution-model ID/basis and quote, depth/capacity, consumed/remaining capacity, impact-model or conservative-proxy foreign key/hash and quote, conservative-proxy or no-fill evidence appropriate to that basis are documented. A fill cannot exceed remaining displayed/model capacity, including under FILL_TIME_QUOTE; insufficient capacity requires the frozen conservative proxy or no-fill path.

For instrument_category ETF, execution_order_ledger.intended_execution_side and execution_side, plus execution_fill_ledger.execution_side, must never be OPEN_SHORT or CLOSE_SHORT; portfolio_position_lot_mark_ledger.position_side must never be SHORT. ETF borrow/short capability is not modelled, so any such row is INVALID rather than a synthetic hedge or implicit assumption.
Cash yield, debit financing, collateral yield, initial/maintenance margin and variation/final-settlement transfer timing are source-backed and dated.

Each cash/debit/collateral term is bound to broker route, clearing/account entity, currency and typed scope, with day-count, compounding, accrual start/end and transfer-cutoff convention. Effective terms resolve only by frozen CONTRACT, INSTRUMENT, INSTRUMENT_CATEGORY, ACCOUNT_WIDE precedence; equal-priority conflict, lower-priority override or missing match is invalid.

For each order or dated ledger event, a deterministic role-applicability audit evaluates CASH_BALANCE, DEBIT_BALANCE, COLLATERAL, TRADE_SETTLEMENT, INITIAL_MARGIN, MAINTENANCE_MARGIN, VARIATION_MARGIN and FINAL_SETTLEMENT. A submitted order requires CASH_BALANCE and a cash-transfer settlement role when applicable; filled derivatives require every triggered margin role. A role can be not applicable only with source-proven effective route/contract/rule evidence.

Every cash, debit, collateral, trade-settlement and margin transfer is a typed dated event linked to a daily portfolio ledger and, if order-linked, to its order and fill leg. The event records route, account, currency, instrument/category context, event_type, mapped application_role, term set, resolved term/source revision and amount. Aggregate ledger currency and any FX conversion policy/source/time are explicit.

Fee/tax components have dated broker_fee_term or tax_levy_term foreign keys, source revisions, amounts, explicit output currencies, FX conversion evidence where needed and tax jurisdiction. Their ledger event_type is FEES_TAX, each component is directly fill_id-linked and daily-cash-linked, reconciles exactly to the component and does not use a cash-yield or margin pricing term; CASH_BALANCE applicability is audited separately.

Order quantities satisfy target > 0 and 0 <= filled <= submitted <= target. A non-submitted/pre-submit-rejected path has zero submitted/filled quantity and a frozen stage/code/reference. A partial residual is explicitly carried, expired, cancelled or execution-failed and has fill-leg settlement/fee allocation; it cannot be relabeled zero-fill. execution_state and settlement_state remain separate, and every open/pending state has the frozen end-of-run carry/cancel treatment.
Tax scope identifies generic statutory treatment versus unverified individual-specific treatment; neither may be silently represented as personal net tax.
daily_ledger_required_fields: date, valuation timestamp and unitization event ID
pre-flow NAV/unit count, external flow/currency, issued/redeemed units, post-flow NAV/unit count and unit NAV
listed-security position IDs, lot IDs, settled/available/reserved quantities, lot size, marks, mark timestamp/source and marked value
futures positions, actual settlement variation, margin and collateral
typed cashflow/P&L rows separating price P&L, event income, roll P&L, funding P&L, execution cost and tax
cash/debit/collateral route/scope term, rate, day-count, accrual period, transfer cutoff and accrued amount
cash-collateral term-set identifier and linked order-state-transition ledger state
cash/collateral role-applicability audit with effective trigger and source-proven not-applicable reason
typed dated cash/margin/settlement events, exact event-type/application-role mapping, order/fill-leg/daily-ledger linkage, currency/base-currency and FX reconciliation
execution-model ID/basis, typed tradability-session reference, legal-session/limit state, quote/proxy/no-fill evidence, separate execution_state/settlement_state and quantity/partial-residual state
immutable fill-leg sequence, price/currency, broker/tax component FKs, jurisdiction, component amounts and settlement allocation
end-of-run carry/cancel disposition, timestamp, reservation release/carry and unresolved obligation state
initial/maintenance margin, variation-margin and final-settlement transfer state
total NAV and cash/position/margin/NAV reconciliation residual with tolerance and exception reference
reconciliation: Reconcile each ETF adjustment/event to cash flows exactly once.
Reconcile futures settlement P&L to clearing-cash movement exactly once.
Separate price P&L, event income, roll P&L, funding/collateral and execution costs.

risk_and_feasibility_controls.freeze_boundary: Before any outcome is viewed, the future rulebook must hash-bind the numerical limits, measurement definitions, escalation owners and pass/fail logic for every control below. A result cannot borrow a threshold, exception or interpretation selected after returns are viewed.
required_control_families: maximum drawdown and path-dependent loss controls at declared daily, weekly and monthly horizons
gross, net, instrument, issuer, sector, commodity-group and correlated-exposure concentration controls
futures margin, collateral, variation-margin, maintenance-margin, delivery/expiry and forced-reduction controls
liquidity, capacity, minimum-lot, tick, T+1, price-limit, halt, no-fill and exit-time feasibility controls
gap, limit-lock, stale-quote, roll-failure, data-failure and counterparty/route failure stress controls
cash/debit/funding, tax, fee and collateral-yield treatment with route/account/scope boundaries
instrument-specific legal, broker-route and suitability evidence; missing evidence is an ineligible/no-action state rather than an inferred permission
required_outputs: daily and period-end control values, limit, status, breach, action and exception references
stress and historical-regime result tables, including worst path and recovery/forced-reduction states
capacity/liquidity assumptions, quote-age/depth evidence and no-fill/partial-fill frequencies
per-parent-class feasibility result and unresolved-evidence status
risk_and_feasibility_controls.pass_boundary: Every required control must be computable from accepted evidence, satisfy its pre-frozen pass rule, and reconcile to the daily/order/cash/position ledgers. A missing, breached, unreconciled or post-result-modified control blocks usable-strategy status even if the return hurdle passes.

mandatory_anti_leakage_tests: Point-in-time timestamp assertion for every decision input.
Historical membership, termination, delisting and expiry test.
Fill legality and no-fill state-machine test.
Conditional submission-path timestamp test for submitted, pre-submit-rejected and not-submitted orders.
Cash/collateral role-applicability and effective-term trigger test.
Cash/collateral scope-precedence, typed ledger-event and currency/FX reconciliation test.
Contiguous order-transition-chain, side, quantity, timestamp and settlement-link invariant test.
Execution-model/basis, typed tradability-session, legal-limit and quote/proxy/no-fill causality test.
Partial-fill residual terminal-state and filled-portion settlement test.
Fee/tax dated-source, component-currency, event-to-order and daily-cash no-double-count test.
Primary-holdout start-state provenance, neutral-reset/reconstruction and component-hash reconciliation test.
Keyed endpoint-result, partition, predicate-audit and start-state-manifest linkage test.
Lineage test from endpoint row to raw hash and source revision.
Deterministic rerun test: identical frozen inputs produce identical decisions, order ledger, daily NAV and endpoint table.

endpoint_table_fields: input-manifest hashes and source revision cut-off
holdings and target versus filled exposure
endpoint_count_fields: expected/actual primary-holdout candidate-endpoint count and primary-holdout status
reconciled all-history endpoint total and partition exception state
supplemental_outputs: Full daily ledger.
Population and eligibility audit.
Data coverage and reconciliation report.
Rule-version and override log.
U0-to-T2 derivation audit and coverage-restriction label.
Development/primary-holdout/crossing partition reconciliation and all-history/primary result labels.
Expected/actual primary-holdout endpoint counts, PRIMARY_HOLDOUT PASS/FAIL/INCOMPLETE/INVALID counts, strict Boolean-hurdle audit and validated-result eligibility label.
Overlap-dependence disclosure, deterministic non-overlapping-window selection audit and predeclared regime/stress summaries.
PRIMARY_HOLDOUT predicate audit with window start/end, warmup/lookback, input available_at boundary and partition reason.
PRIMARY_HOLDOUT start-state manifest with reset/reconstruction interval, component hashes, integrity status and crossing/invalid exceptions.
Keyed replay endpoint-result table with partition, status, input hash, predicate audit and PRIMARY_HOLDOUT manifest linkage.
Order-state-transition matrix, transition ledger and invalid-transition exceptions.
Conditional submission-path timestamp audit and cash/collateral role-applicability audit.
Scope-resolution decision log, typed cash/margin/settlement event ledger, daily-ledger linkage and currency/FX reconciliation audit.
Order-transition-chain invariant audit, including sequence, adjacency, terminal state, quantity, timestamp, side and settlement-event reconciliation.
Execution-model/tradability/quote-or-proxy audit, partial-fill residual audit and fee/tax source-currency-to-daily-cash reconciliation audit.
Prospective paper state/configuration coverage matrix, evidence disposition and unresolved-row audit.
Frozen risk-and-feasibility control pack, per-control pass/fail audit and usable-strategy conjunctive-status audit.
Stress, liquidity and cross-asset overlap analysis.
Independent raw-to-output reconciliation and prospective paper-ledger comparison.

formal_run_entry_conditions: DPSFS-DAC-v12 or later has a signed freeze record and UR01-UR03 package acceptance.
A U0 population snapshot, U0-to-T2 derivation audit and class-neutral decision-universe rule are frozen.
Every U0 parent class represented in T2 has an accepted data package and replay-protocol module; otherwise the run is coverage-restricted and labeled as such.
All currently unbound fields are fixed in a versioned rulebook before outcome inspection.
The protocol ID, version and SHA-256 are bound in the same freeze record as the rulebook, contract, U0 snapshot, derivation audit and data dictionary.

The single canonical freeze record cross-binds input/revision/code/runtime/command, lockbox/predicate/start-state policy, state-transition matrix, conditional submission-path/timestamp policy, cash/collateral role-applicability/scope-resolution policies, transition-chain invariant, cash/margin/settlement event schema, execution-model/tradability, partial-fill, fee-tax/currency and endpoint-result policies, and risk-feasibility pack; every echoed value must match byte-for-byte before outcome view.

The frozen reporting population requires at least 252 candidate rolling endpoints and the actual count must equal the frozen expected count; zero, shortfall or count mismatch produces INCOMPLETE, not a pass.

PRIMARY_HOLDOUT strict hurdle requires actual_primary_holdout_candidate_endpoint_count = expected_primary_holdout_candidate_endpoint_count >= 126 AND every PRIMARY_HOLDOUT candidate endpoint is PASS; no independent out-of-sample or validated-strategy label is permitted on a zero, shortfall, mismatch, FAIL, INCOMPLETE or INVALID primary state.

The exact PRIMARY_HOLDOUT window predicate, post-lockbox start-state policy, post-freeze invalidation rule, deterministic non-overlapping summary and regime/stress classification are frozen and pass their audit before outcome view.

The frozen rulebook binds an allowed order-state-transition matrix, conditional submission-path timestamps, cash/collateral role-applicability/scope-resolution triggers, transition-chain invariant, typed cash/margin/settlement event schema, execution-model/tradability, partial-fill and fee-tax/currency policies; every transition, event and role conclusion reconciles to the order, daily cash and position ledgers.

The prospective paper state/configuration coverage matrix covers every applicable parent class, route/term set, cash/collateral role/scope, material transaction type, event type, execution-model/tradability path, partial-fill residual and state/transition with an observed, accepted-conservative or source-proven-not-applicable disposition; an unresolved row blocks usable status.

The frozen risk-and-feasibility control pack defines numerical limits, measurement and escalation logic for drawdown/loss, concentration, margin, liquidity/capacity, no-fill/limit/gap/roll stress, funding and instrument-specific route/suitability evidence; every control must pass and reconcile to the ledgers.

The keyed endpoint-result table reconciles every candidate exactly once across DEVELOPMENT, PRIMARY_HOLDOUT and CROSSING; every PRIMARY_HOLDOUT row has its predicate audit and PASS start-state-manifest linkage; CROSSING is disclosed separately and vetoes the all-history hurdle when it fails.
The anti-leakage suite passes and the first permitted outcome-view timestamp is recorded.
Independent R0/R1/risk reviewers approve execution of the replay, not an investment action.

A usable-strategy status is released only after every applicable all-history, primary-holdout, coverage, data, risk/feasibility, route/cost, paper-reconciliation and review condition passes together; otherwise q remains 0.
current_decision: No current rulebook satisfies this protocol. There is no formal result, allocation, holding or action, and q remains 0.
